name: Koshino Kozue
source:
Working part-time as an amusement attendant, Kozue trudged through high school with poor academic performance. Unable to pass college entrance exams, her life has generally spiraled into an idle dead stop. Kozue often dreams about finding a sugar daddy to take care of her, and is quite the genius at gourmet cooking thanks to her mother’s culinary experience.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
